    A⁽⁴⁾ = 𝒪P and its reduction to A⁽²⁾ (Proposition 10.1, the algebra) #

    "Its projective corner is A⁽²⁾ […]. Put A⁽⁴⁾ = 𝒪P, graded by length."

    Setting (TabIso): a scalar mesh category over 𝔽₂ with mesh data D and a ray table P with a ray degree d and an isomorphism Θ : 𝔽₂P ≅ A⁽²⁾ taking every ray to a homogeneous element of its degree and the vertex rays to the vertex idempotents (for C⁽²⁾ this is IndSkeleton.Θ₂). Then A⁽⁴⁾ = 𝒪P is graded by the degrees of the rays (galgO), and the reduction π : 𝒪P → 𝔽₂P ≅ A⁽²⁾ is a reduction of graded algebras (isRed_πO).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

    Type

    A ray table of A⁽²⁾: ray degrees and Θ : 𝔽₂P ≅ A⁽²⁾, homogeneous on the rays and matching the vertex idempotents.

    • d : R → ℤ
    • d_mul (r s t : R) : P.mul r s = some t → self.d t = self.d r + self.d s
    • d_e (x : D.PV) : self.d (P.e x) = 0
    • d_nonneg (r : R) : 0 ≤ self.d r
    • Θ : ↥(P.Lin (ZMod 2)) ≃ₐ[ZMod 2] (CatAlg.Alg D.F0)ᵐᵒᵖ
    • Θ_hom (r : R) : (lenA0 D ⋯).IsHom (self.d r).toNat (self.Θ (P.b (ZMod 2) r))
    • Θ_e (x : D.PV) : self.Θ (P.b (ZMod 2) (P.e x)) = eP D x
